Russell Pinkston | Russell Pinkston (born January 1, 1949) is a professor of composition and the director of the electronic music studios at the University of Texas at Austin School of Music.
Ryan Pinkston | Ryan James Pinkston (born February 8, 1988) is an American actor and model.  He was a cast member on "Punk'd" and played Billy Hunkee in "Soul Plane".

JayVaughn Pinkston | JayVaughn Pinkston (born November 27, 1991) is an American professional basketball player for Dinamica Mantova of the Italian Serie A2 Citroën.  He played college basketball for Villanova University.
